phases.name: Phase 1 - Winter Program
notEncoded: Novice/Technique Onboarding Track (alternate 3-week RPE 6-7 dumbbell/goblet/bodyweight track for true first-timers and flagged athletes) - coach judgment / written program
Multi-Sport Maintenance Track (2-day/week version for winter-sport athletes; same intensity as standard track but accessory circuit cut) - coach judgment / written program
Auto-regulation (drop load 5-10% if prescribed reps aren't achievable) - runtime rule, not fixed program data
Position-based load bias (linemen/skill-position +/-2.5% band around the prescribed %) - coach judgment, not encoded as a separate numeric track

squat.note: Work up to a heavy 5RM. Convert to e1RM (5RM / 0.87, nearest 2.5 lb) immediately after; every later % in this phase is of this e1RM.

bench.note: Work up to a heavy 5RM. Same e1RM conversion as squat.

deadlift.note: Work up to a heavy 5RM. Same e1RM conversion as squat.

ohp.note: Work up to a heavy 5RM (Day 4/Friday). Same e1RM conversion. Missed test is picked up at start of Week 2 Day C.

pullup.scheme: Max strict bodyweight reps (no added weight/assistance) after 2 easy warm-up sets. 8+ reps -> rest 5 min, then test a weighted 5RM (belt/vest added weight) = Weighted-track baseline. Under 8 reps -> that rep count is the Bodyweight/Assisted-track baseline (rep-based progression, no weight). Cannot do a bodyweight pull-up -> test lat pulldown/assisted pull-up 5RM instead, same rep-based track.

squat.note: Reintroduction after Winter Break - 3 sets (volume dip), technique check under load

bench.note: Reintroduction after Winter Break - 3 sets (volume dip), technique check under load

deadlift.note: Reintroduction after Winter Break - 3 sets (volume dip), technique check under load Alternates with Romanian Deadlift every other week; on RDL weeks the % is a ceiling, not a target.

pullup.scheme: Weighted track: 3x5 @ 75% of tested weighted 5RM e1RM (same weekly exceptions as other main lifts), back-off = 10-12 bodyweight-only reps. Bodyweight/Assisted track: 3 sets x max reps (after 2 warm-up sets of 3-5), progressing toward 8+ reps to graduate onto the Weighted track; no back-off set.

deadlift.note: Alternates with Romanian Deadlift every other week; on RDL weeks the % is a ceiling, not a target.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Early Summer Program
notEncoded: First-time-athlete tracks: Bench/Pull-up/OHP RPE 6-7 technique track (Test Week, Week 2; ramped 5RM test at Week 3) and Squat/Deadlift's longer 3-session Goblet Squat/DB RDL technique track (Test Week, Weeks 2, 3; Squat 5RM test Week 4, Deadlift 5RM test Week 5) - coach judgment / written program, no e1RM on file to compute
Experienced-lifter fast lane (coach discretion, upper-body three only) - coach judgment / written program
Staggered and Late Arrivals catch-up protocols and the hard three-session floor for Squat/Deadlift - coach judgment / written program
Sled load by week, SIT volume, Day A/B/C content (non-barbell sessions) - written program, not in the app
Auto-regulation (sled technique breakdown -> drop load 5-10%; same for Day D barbell work) - runtime rule, not fixed program data
Retest Week battery (Monday speed: bodyweight, 10m/20m, 40-yard; Tuesday 300-yard shuttle; Thursday makeups) - written program, not in the app
Late-arriving first-time athletes' standalone Retest Week on-ramp (capped-load sled work, technique content in place of the Retest Week lift; tests fall to Phase 4) - coach judgment / written program
No Nordic hamstring curl and no sled, plyometric or SIT work in the Retest Week - written program

weeks.label: Test Week (Day D - Wed, upper body only)

squat.note: No Squat this week for returning athletes: the legs have just done maximal sprints (Monday) and the 300-yard shuttle (Tuesday). The light Squat touch starts in Week 2. First-time athletes run technique session 1 (Goblet Squat, RPE 6) instead - written program, no e1RM to compute.

deadlift.note: No Deadlift this week for returning athletes - same reasoning as Squat. First-time athletes run technique session 1 (DB Romanian Deadlift, RPE 6).

bench.note: Upper-body-only Day D, off the most recently tested (Phase 2 Week 7) e1RM. 2-3 min rest. First-time athletes run technique session 1 (DB bench, RPE 6-7); an experienced lifter cleared by the coach may run a coach-watched ramp to a 5RM here (fast lane).

ohp.note: Same dosing as Bench. First-time athletes: DB overhead press technique session 1, RPE 6-7.

pullup.scheme: Weighted: 3x5 at ~80% of total-load e1RM (bodyweight + added weight; belt load = that minus bodyweight). Bodyweight: 3x5 with 2-3 reps in reserve (same technique-gating standard as Phase 1).
pullup.note: Test Week upper-body Day D, same dose as Weeks 2-5. First-time athletes: inverted or band row technique, RPE 6-7.

squat.note: Returning athletes only - light motor-pattern maintenance touch (not a strength stimulus), off Phase 2 Week 7 e1RM. 90 sec rest. First-time athletes skip this and run Goblet Squat/DB RDL technique session 2 (RPE 7).

bench.note: Upper-body maintenance lift, off most recently tested (Phase 2 Week 7) e1RM. 2-3 min rest.

deadlift.note: Returning athletes only - same light maintenance touch and reasoning as Squat above.

ohp.note: Same maintenance-lift dosing as Bench.

pullup.scheme: Weighted: 3x5 at ~80% of total-load e1RM (bodyweight + added weight; belt load = that minus bodyweight). Bodyweight: 3x5 with 2-3 reps in reserve (same technique-gating standard as Phase 1).
pullup.note: Flat dose, unchanged Weeks 2-5.

squat.note: Same as Week 2 - flat dose. First-time athletes run technique session 3 of 3 (Goblet Squat, RPE 7) - Squat and Deadlift are never tested on this day.

bench.note: Same as Week 2 - flat dose. First-time athletes who look clean in the screen and two technique sessions test a ramped, coach-watched 5RM here (stop at the first technique breakdown).

deadlift.note: Returning athletes only - same light maintenance touch and reasoning as Squat above.

ohp.note: Same as Week 2 - flat dose. First-time athletes: ramped 5RM test if clean, same rules as Bench.

pullup.scheme: Weighted: 3x5 at ~80% of total-load e1RM (bodyweight + added weight; belt load = that minus bodyweight). Bodyweight: 3x5 with 2-3 reps in reserve (same technique-gating standard as Phase 1).
pullup.note: Same as Week 2 - flat dose. First-time athletes: ramped 5RM (or bodyweight/assisted branch) if clean.

squat.note: Same as Week 2 - flat dose. First-time athletes who banked three technique sessions run their Squat 5RM TEST here (July 14), in place of this maintenance touch: empty-bar gate first, ramp, stop at first breakdown, DB RDL 2x5 RPE 6 as the light touch on the other lift. Upper-body fallback test slot if no lower-body test is due.

bench.note: Upper-body maintenance lift, off most recently tested (Phase 2 Week 7) e1RM. 2-3 min rest.

deadlift.note: Returning athletes only - same light maintenance touch and reasoning as Squat above.

ohp.note: Same maintenance-lift dosing as Bench.

pullup.scheme: Weighted: 3x5 at ~80% of total-load e1RM (bodyweight + added weight; belt load = that minus bodyweight). Bodyweight: 3x5 with 2-3 reps in reserve (same technique-gating standard as Phase 1).

bridges.name: Camp Bridge (Phase 3 to 4, once two-a-days begin)
bridges.description: No lifting in the first 5 days of NJSIAA's 14-day heat-acclimatization ramp. Once two-a-day sessions begin (Day 6 onward), this once-a-week session (Phase 3's Retest Week lift dose) continues through the rest of camp to the season opener.

weeks.week: once-weekly, Day 6 of acclimatization ramp onward
weeks.label: Camp Bridge Lift

squat.note: Light maintenance touch, continues from Phase 3's Day D (paused for Phase 3's Retest Week and the blackout week). Closes the gap where Squat/Deadlift would otherwise go fully dormant from Phase 2's close through camp.

bench.note: Continues Phase 3's Retest Week lift dose unchanged.

deadlift.note: Same maintenance touch and reasoning as Squat above.

ohp.note: Continues Phase 3's Retest Week lift dose unchanged.

pullup.scheme: Weighted: 2x5 at ~75% of total-load e1RM (bodyweight + added weight; belt load = that minus bodyweight). Bodyweight: 2x5 with 2-3 reps in reserve, no added weight.
pullup.note: Scheduled into whichever of that day's two practice sessions (or that week's single-practice day) leaves the most practical window - camp's daily schedule is the football staff's to set.

notEncoded: Conditioning (end-of-practice SIT shuttle work) - uses Phase 3's Day C template, scaled to the practice window; not a barbell-lift prescription
First-time athlete (no off-season e1RM) RPE-based substitute - coach judgment / written program

phase5.name: Phase 4 - In-Season
phase5.structure: Ongoing weekly, keyed to game day (GD-4 / GD-2 labels, not fixed weekdays), not a fixed week count. Flat at 80-85% e1RM ('Heavy Maintenance' pace) once fully ramped in, with a Week 1-2 re-entry ramp for Squat/Deadlift only.

squat.note: Re-entry ramp week 1 of 2 - Squat/Deadlift's Phase 2 Week 7 e1RM is ~3-4 months old by the opener; Bench/Pull-up never went dormant and start at full 80-85% from Week 1.

deadlift.note: Same re-entry ramp as Squat.

bench.note: No ramp - starts at full prescription, never went dormant (Phase 3/4 Day D kept it current).

ohp.note: Not part of Phase 4's rotation at all - see steadyState.ohp.

pullup.note: No ramp - starts at full prescription (same as Bench).
pullup.scheme: Weighted load: ~80% of total-load e1RM (bodyweight + added weight); belt load = that minus bodyweight.

squat.note: Re-entry ramp week 2 of 2.

deadlift.note: Same re-entry ramp as Squat.

bench.note: Full prescription (unchanged).

pullup.note: Full prescription (unchanged).
pullup.scheme: Weighted load: ~80% of total-load e1RM (bodyweight + added weight); belt load = that minus bodyweight.

squat.note: Full prescription for the remainder of the season, subject to the Monday auto-regulation note and the sRPE/ACWR tracking system (runtime rules, not encoded as numbers here).

deadlift.note: Same as Squat.

squat.note: 'Heavy Maintenance' pace - controlled/purposeful bar speed, deliberately NOT labeled CAT (CAT stays defined at 50-70% e1RM elsewhere in this program). Off each athlete's most recently tested e1RM (Phase 2 Week 7 retest).

bench.note: Same Heavy Maintenance pace as Squat. Runs alongside Squat on GD-4.

deadlift.note: Same Heavy Maintenance pace as Squat. (Or RDL if technique/load management calls for it.)

ohp.note: Overhead Press is explicitly NOT part of Phase 4's rotation - Bench Press already covers the push pattern on the phase's two lift days, and a 2-lift-per-day maintenance phase has no room for a fifth exercise. Not tested or prescribed again until a later program cycle.

pullup.note: Weighted: 3 sets x 3-5 reps at ~80% of total-load e1RM (bodyweight + added weight; belt load = that minus bodyweight). Bodyweight: 3x3-5 with 2-3 reps in reserve. Same Heavy Maintenance intensity standard, full prescription from Week 1 (never went dormant off-season).

phase5.mondayAutoRegulationNote: GD-4 (Monday, for a typical Friday-game week) lands ~60-65 hours post-game, inside the 24-72hr post-game muscle-damage window. After a high-snap-count/physically demanding game, default to the LOW END of 80-85% e1RM, or drop to 2 work sets instead of 3, based on coaching judgment and the prior week's sRPE/ACWR data. A quiet week with no unusual game toll runs the full prescription as written. (This is a runtime/coach-judgment rule, not a fixed number - included here descriptively per the schema, not as program data to apply automatically.)
notEncoded: sRPE/ACWR load-tracking system (the mechanism that replaces a mid-season retest) - runtime/data-collection system, not a lift prescription
First-time athletes arriving after the off-season program (RPE-based substitute until a real 5RM test clears them) - coach judgment / written program
General auto-regulation (drop 5-10% on technique breakdown) - runtime rule
